writing.title: An Unexpected Day
writing.prompt_cn: 用过去完成时(had + 过去分词)写一篇短文,讲一件出乎意料的事(如睡过头、坐错车、被开玩笑)。用by the time/when等表达事情发生的先后。60词左右。
key_points: 用过去完成时说明先发生了什么(had done)
useful_expressions: When I ..., I realized I had ...
It was full of the unexpected.
writing.sample: Last Monday was full of the unexpected. I overslept. By the time I woke up, it was already eight o'clock. I got ready in a hurry. But when I got to the bus stop, the bus had already left. I had to walk to school. By the time I arrived, the first class had started. I felt terrible. But my teacher was kind and let me in. In the end, I learned to set my alarm earlier.

scoring.content: 含意外事件/先后顺序/感受/结果(4分)
scoring.language: 正确使用过去完成时had+过去分词(3分)
